description: Polls an audio project until it completes, errors, is canceled or times out. Use with the id returned by an audio create tool. Read-only; returns the project and download URLs, with optional inline audio previews sharing an 8 MiB total limit. After a timeout, resume with the same id rather than creating another generation. Use signed download URLs exactly as returned.

id.description: Existing project ID returned by the matching creation tool. Reuse this ID after a wait timeout.

include_inline_downloads.description: Whether to include image or audio previews for completed projects. Download URLs remain available if preview fetching fails.

max_bytes_per_download.description: Positive maximum raw bytes per preview, capped by the remaining 8 MiB total budget. Larger outputs remain available by URL.

max_inline_downloads.description: Maximum number of previews to include. Zero or negative disables previews; previews share an 8 MiB total limit.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between status checks. Must be finite and nonnegative; values below 0.5 use 0.5 seconds.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds for this wait call, finite and greater than zero. Timeout does not cancel the project or start another generation.

name: wait_for_audio_project

outputSchema.description: Existing project status and exact output links. A wait timeout is not a generation failure; resume with the same ID.

download_expiration_metadata.description: Expiration metadata only. Never append it to a download URL.

download_index.description: Zero-based index in the upstream download list, encoded as text.

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp provided by the API.

note.description: Guidance for preserving the signed URL.

downloads.description: Available output files with exact signed URLs. May be absent until completion.

url.description: Use this signed download URL unchanged, including all query parameters.

exact_download_urls.description: Convenience list of the same unmodified signed output URLs.

id.description: Existing project identifier, retained for subsequent status checks.

last_project.description: Last observed API project snapshot if the wait timed out after a successful status check.

message.description: Wait timeout or recovery guidance, when present.

status.description: Project status such as complete, error or canceled; timeout means only this wait call ended.

title: Wait for Audio Project
